articles.summary: NVIDIA's BioNeMo Agent Toolkit brings powerful foundation models to life sciences. But agents are only as reliable as the data they run on. TetraScience explains why the data substrate is the deciding factor — and what that looks like in practice.
articles.title: Why AI Agents Need Better Scientific Data: TetraScience and the NVIDIA BioNeMo Agent Toolkit

articles.summary: Scientists at large pharma spend up to 32,000 hours a year reviewing CRO data. Here's why — and what closes the loop.
articles.title: What If Your CRO Data Was Ready to Use the Moment It Arrived?
